command: set -u; echo '=== UNIT SHOW ==='; systemctl show entityos-vm.service --no-pager -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p FragmentPath -p DropInPaths -p ExecStartPre -p ExecStart -p ExecStopPost; echo '=== UNIT CAT ==='; systemctl cat entityos-vm.service --no-pager 2>&1 || true; echo '=== DISPOSABLE SEMANTIC DBS ==='; sudo -n find /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share -xdev -type f -name '*.db' -printf '%p|%s|%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>&1 | sort || true; echo '=== DURABLE DATA FILES ==='; sudo -n find /var/lib/entityos/data -xdev -maxdepth 4 -type f -printf '%p|%s|%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>&1 | sort || true; echo '=== DROPIN DIRS ==='; sudo -n find /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d /usr/lib/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d -maxdepth 2 -type f -print -exec sh -c 'echo --- $1; cat $1' _ {} \; 2>&1 || true; echo '=== DB HASHES ==='; for f in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db; do if sudo -n test -f "$f"; then sudo -n sha256sum "$f"; else echo MISSING:$f; fi; done
